subject.title: fix: harden cloud worker admission and remote turns

question: Has Crabbox v0.38.1 or newer been published and verified through every supported OpenClaw install channel so AWS cloud workers will not fail closed after this PR lands?
rationale: The patch intentionally requires new authoritative inspection metadata; code review cannot establish dependency publication and rollout readiness.

options.title: Verify and land
options.body: Publish Crabbox v0.38.1+, verify supported installs and live AWS admission, refresh the branch, and then merge.

options.title: Hold the PR
options.body: Keep the PR open and unmerged until supported install channels expose the required inspection contract.

recommendation.title: Verify and land
recommendation.body: Publish Crabbox v0.38.1+, verify supported installs and live AWS admission, refresh the branch, and then merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current assignee owns the linked cloud-worker direction and has coordinated the companion Crabbox contract and release gate.
